---
title: "Explore a random forest"
toc: false
page-layout: full
---

A random forest extends bagging. Like bagging, it fits many trees on
**bootstrap samples** of one training dataset and averages their predictions.
It adds a second source of diversity: at each split, a tree considers only a
random subset of the available features.

::: {.callout-tip}
## What to watch

Add trees one at a time. Each tree receives a different bootstrap sample and,
at every split, only a random subset of the features. Each tree is limited to
depth 5, so it can vary without fitting every leaf perfectly. Inspect its root
rule and held-out AUC. For the fixed new observation, compare the individual
tree probabilities with their pooled average, then watch how the random
forest's held-out AUC changes as more trees are added.
:::

```{=html}
<div id="random-forest-explorer" class="bagging-explorer" aria-label="Interactive random-forest explorer">
  <div class="bagging-toolbar">
    <div class="clt-buttons" aria-label="Random-forest growth controls">
      <button id="rf-next-tree" type="button" class="regression-sampling-primary">Add next tree</button>
      <button id="rf-run-all" type="button">Run all trees</button>
      <button id="rf-reset" type="button">Reset</button>
    </div>
    <div class="bagging-progress" aria-live="polite">
      <span>Trees built:</span>
      <strong><output id="rf-tree-count">1</output>/<span id="rf-total-tree-count">200</span></strong>
    </div>
  </div>

  <section class="bagging-step" aria-labelledby="rf-bootstrap-heading">
    <div class="bagging-step-heading">
      <span class="bagging-step-number">1</span>
      <div>
        <h2 id="rf-bootstrap-heading">Make a bootstrap dataset</h2>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="rf-bootstrap-summary" class="bagging-bootstrap-summary"></div>
  </section>

  <section class="bagging-step bagging-tree-step" aria-labelledby="rf-tree-heading">
    <div class="bagging-step-heading">
      <span class="bagging-step-number">2</span>
      <div>
        <h2 id="rf-tree-heading">Fit one tree with random feature candidates</h2>
        <p>At every node, this tree considers a fresh random set of 3 of the 9 features, then selects the best available split. Beyond its root rule, the heatmap shows how the tree distributes its total Gini reduction across the nine features.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="rf-tree-card" class="bagging-tree-card" aria-label="Root rule and held-out performance of the newest random-forest tree"></div>
  </section>

  <section class="bagging-step" aria-labelledby="rf-prediction-heading">
    <div class="bagging-step-heading">
      <span class="bagging-step-number">3</span>
      <div>
        <h2 id="rf-prediction-heading">Pool the tree predictions for one new observation</h2>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="rf-prediction-card" class="bagging-prediction-card" aria-label="Fixed held-out operating observation and the current random-forest prediction"></div>
  </section>

  <section class="bagging-step" aria-labelledby="rf-evaluation-heading">
    <div class="bagging-step-heading">
      <span class="bagging-step-number">4</span>
      <div>
        <h2 id="rf-evaluation-heading">Evaluate the random forest</h2>
        <p>Every model is evaluated against the same held-out dataset. Adding trees changes the averaged forest probability, not the data used for evaluation.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <figure class="bagging-figure">
      <figcaption>Held-out AUC as random-forest trees are added</figcaption>
      <svg id="rf-auc-chart" role="img" aria-label="Held-out AUC as random-forest trees are added"></svg>
    </figure>
  </section>
</div>

The samples, fitted-tree summaries, predictions, and AUC values are precomputed
from the gas-turbine data. The page reveals real fitted trees; it does not
train models in the browser.

<p style="margin-top: 1.5rem;"><a href="index.html">← Return to Tree-based models</a></p>

<script src="../assets/random-forest-explorer.js"></script>
<script>
(() => {
  const root = document.getElementById("random-forest-explorer");
  const explorer = window.MECE4520RandomForestExplorer;
  if (!root || !explorer) return;

  const treeCountOutput = root.querySelector("#rf-tree-count");
  const totalTreeCount = root.querySelector("#rf-total-tree-count");
  const nextButton = root.querySelector("#rf-next-tree");
  const runButton = root.querySelector("#rf-run-all");
  const resetButton = root.querySelector("#rf-reset");
  const bootstrapSummary = root.querySelector("#rf-bootstrap-summary");
  const treeCard = root.querySelector("#rf-tree-card");
  const predictionCard = root.querySelector("#rf-prediction-card");
  const aucChart = root.querySelector("#rf-auc-chart");

  if (!treeCountOutput || !totalTreeCount || !nextButton
      || !runButton || !resetButton || !bootstrapSummary || !treeCard
      || !predictionCard || !aucChart) return;

  const colors = {
    forest: "#457eaa",
    individual: "#d77732",
    grid: "#d8e1e5",
    axis: "#5d6a72"
  };
  const nTrees = explorer.metadata.nTrees;
  let includedTrees = 1;
  let animationFrame = null;
  let lastFrameTime = 0;
  let isRunning = false;

  totalTreeCount.textContent = String(nTrees);

  function svgElement(name, attributes = {}) {
    const element = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", name);
    Object.entries(attributes).forEach(([key, value]) => element.setAttribute(key, value));
    return element;
  }

  function addText(svg, text, x, y, attributes = {}) {
    const element = svgElement("text", Object.assign({ x, y }, attributes));
    element.textContent = text;
    svg.append(element);
    return element;
  }

  function addTitleAndDescription(svg, titleText, descriptionText) {
    const title = svgElement("title", { id: svg.id + "-title" });
    const description = svgElement("desc", { id: svg.id + "-description" });
    title.textContent = titleText;
    description.textContent = descriptionText;
    svg.append(title, description);
    svg.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", title.id + " " + description.id);
  }

  function scale(value, domain, range) {
    return range[0] + ((value - domain[0]) / (domain[1] - domain[0])) * (range[1] - range[0]);
  }

  function activeTree() {
    return explorer.forest.trees[includedTrees - 1];
  }

  function currentProbability() {
    const probabilities = explorer.predictionObservation.treeProbabilities.slice(0, includedTrees);
    return probabilities.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / probabilities.length;
  }

  function renderBootstrapSummary() {
    const bootstrap = activeTree().bootstrap;
    bootstrapSummary.replaceChildren();
    const values = [
      ["Draws", bootstrap.draws.toLocaleString(), "same size as the original training set"],
      ["Unique source rows", bootstrap.uniqueRows.toLocaleString() + " (" + (100 * bootstrap.uniqueRows / explorer.metadata.nTraining).toFixed(1) + "%)", "rows appearing at least once"],
      ["Omitted source rows", bootstrap.omittedRows.toLocaleString() + " (" + (100 * bootstrap.omittedRows / explorer.metadata.nTraining).toFixed(1) + "%)", "rows not selected at all"],
    ];
    values.forEach(([label, value, note]) => {
      const card = document.createElement("div");
      const title = document.createElement("span");
      const number = document.createElement("strong");
      const description = document.createElement("small");
      title.textContent = label;
      number.textContent = value;
      description.textContent = note;
      card.append(title, number, description);
      bootstrapSummary.append(card);
    });
  }

  function renderTreeCard() {
    const tree = activeTree();
    const rootNode = tree.root;
    treeCard.replaceChildren();
    const rootMetric = document.createElement("div");
    rootMetric.className = "bagging-tree-metric";
    const rootLabel = document.createElement("span");
    const rootValue = document.createElement("strong");
    rootLabel.textContent = "Root rule";
    rootValue.textContent = rootNode.feature + " ≤ " + rootNode.threshold.toFixed(3);
    rootMetric.append(rootLabel, rootValue);
    treeCard.append(rootMetric);

    const importance = document.createElement("div");
    importance.className = "bagging-feature-importance";
    const heading = document.createElement("div");
    heading.className = "bagging-feature-importance-heading";
    const title = document.createElement("span");
    title.textContent = "Feature importance in this tree (0.000 = unused)";
    const auc = document.createElement("strong");
    auc.textContent = "This tree's held-out AUC: " + tree.testAuc.toFixed(3);
    heading.append(title, auc);

    const grid = document.createElement("div");
    grid.className = "bagging-feature-importance-grid";
    Object.entries(tree.featureImportances).forEach(([feature, value]) => {
      const isUnused = tree.unusedFeatures.includes(feature);
      const cell = document.createElement("div");
      cell.className = "bagging-feature-importance-cell";
      if (isUnused) {
        cell.classList.add("bagging-feature-importance-cell-unused");
        cell.setAttribute("aria-label", feature + ": not used by this tree");
      } else {
        cell.style.backgroundColor = "hsl(205 56% " + (98 - 52 * value) + "%)";
        cell.style.color = value >= 0.6 ? "#ffffff" : "#23495f";
        cell.setAttribute("aria-label", feature + ": feature importance " + value.toFixed(3));
      }
      const name = document.createElement("span");
      const number = document.createElement("strong");
      name.textContent = feature;
      number.textContent = isUnused ? "Not used" : value.toFixed(3);
      cell.append(name, number);
      grid.append(cell);
    });

    importance.append(heading, grid);
    treeCard.append(importance);
  }

  function renderPredictionCard() {
    const observation = explorer.predictionObservation;
    const probabilities = observation.treeProbabilities;
    const probability = currentProbability();
    predictionCard.replaceChildren();

    const treeOutputs = document.createElement("div");
    treeOutputs.className = "bagging-tree-outputs";
    const outputLabel = document.createElement("span");
    outputLabel.className = "bagging-prediction-label";
    outputLabel.textContent = "One predicted probability from each tree (0 = red; 1 = green)";
    const outputGrid = document.createElement("div");
    outputGrid.className = "bagging-tree-output-grid";
    outputGrid.setAttribute("role", "list");
    for (let index = 0; index < nTrees; index += 1) {
      const output = document.createElement("span");
      output.setAttribute("role", "listitem");
      if (index < includedTrees) {
        const treeProbability = probabilities[index];
        output.className = "bagging-tree-output bagging-tree-output-fitted";
        output.style.setProperty("--probability-hue", String(5 + 130 * treeProbability));
        output.textContent = treeProbability.toFixed(3);
        output.setAttribute("aria-label", "Tree " + (index + 1) + ": predicted probability " + treeProbability.toFixed(3));
      } else {
        output.className = "bagging-tree-output bagging-tree-output-pending";
        output.setAttribute("aria-label", "Tree " + (index + 1) + " has not been fitted yet");
      }
      outputGrid.append(output);
    }
    treeOutputs.append(outputLabel, outputGrid);
    predictionCard.append(treeOutputs);

    const summary = document.createElement("div");
    summary.className = "bagging-prediction-summary";
    const input = document.createElement("div");
    input.className = "bagging-prediction-input";
    const inputLabel = document.createElement("span");
    inputLabel.className = "bagging-prediction-label";
    inputLabel.textContent = "New observation (" + explorer.metadata.nFeatures + " features total; label: " + observation.actualLabel + ")";
    const featureTableWrap = document.createElement("div");
    featureTableWrap.className = "bagging-feature-table-wrap";
    const featureTable = document.createElement("table");
    featureTable.className = "bagging-feature-table";
    const header = document.createElement("thead");
    header.innerHTML = "<tr><th scope=\"col\">Feature</th><th scope=\"col\">Value</th></tr>";
    const body = document.createElement("tbody");
    Object.entries(observation.features).forEach(([feature, value]) => {
      const row = document.createElement("tr");
      const name = document.createElement("th");
      name.scope = "row";
      name.textContent = feature;
      const featureValue = document.createElement("td");
      featureValue.textContent = Number(value).toFixed(2);
      row.append(name, featureValue);
      body.append(row);
    });
    featureTable.append(header, body);
    featureTableWrap.append(featureTable);
    input.append(inputLabel, featureTableWrap);

    const result = document.createElement("div");
    result.className = "bagging-prediction-result";
    const resultLabel = document.createElement("span");
    resultLabel.className = "bagging-prediction-label";
    resultLabel.textContent = "Pooled average";
    const resultValue = document.createElement("strong");
    resultValue.textContent = probability.toFixed(3);
    result.append(resultLabel, resultValue);
    summary.append(input, result);
    predictionCard.append(summary);
  }

  function drawAucChart() {
    const ensembleAuc = explorer.forest.cumulativeTestAuc;
    const individualAuc = explorer.forest.trees.map((tree) => tree.testAuc);
    let individualAucSum = 0;
    const meanIndividualAuc = individualAuc.map((value, index) => {
      individualAucSum += value;
      return individualAucSum / (index + 1);
    });
    const width = 600;
    const height = 275;
    const margin = { top: 38, right: 25, bottom: 54, left: 61 };
    const plotRight = width - margin.right;
    const plotBottom = height - margin.bottom;
    const minimumAuc = Math.min(...ensembleAuc, ...meanIndividualAuc);
    const maximumAuc = Math.max(...ensembleAuc, ...meanIndividualAuc);
    const padding = Math.max(0.003, 0.12 * (maximumAuc - minimumAuc));
    const domain = [
      Math.max(0, minimumAuc - padding),
      Math.min(1, maximumAuc + padding),
    ];
    const xScale = (value) => scale(value, [1, nTrees], [margin.left, plotRight]);
    const yScale = (value) => scale(value, domain, [plotBottom, margin.top]);

    aucChart.replaceChildren();
    aucChart.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 " + width + " " + height);
    aucChart.setAttribute("preserveAspectRatio", "xMidYMid meet");
    addTitleAndDescription(
      aucChart,
      "Held-out AUC while random-forest trees are added",
      "After " + includedTrees + " trees, the random forest has held-out AUC "
      + ensembleAuc[includedTrees - 1].toFixed(3)
      + ", compared with a mean individual-tree AUC of "
      + meanIndividualAuc[includedTrees - 1].toFixed(3) + "."
    );
    const tickStep = maximumAuc - minimumAuc <= 0.04 ? 0.01 : 0.02;
    const yTicks = [];
    for (let tick = Math.ceil(domain[0] / tickStep) * tickStep; tick <= domain[1] + 1e-9; tick += tickStep) {
      yTicks.push(Number(tick.toFixed(3)));
    }
    yTicks.forEach((tick) => {
      const y = yScale(tick);
      aucChart.append(svgElement("line", { x1: margin.left, y1: y, x2: plotRight, y2: y, class: "bagging-chart-grid" }));
      addText(aucChart, tick.toFixed(3), margin.left - 9, y + 4, { class: "bagging-chart-tick", "text-anchor": "end" });
    });
    [1, 50, 100, 150, 200].forEach((tick) => {
      addText(aucChart, String(tick), xScale(tick), plotBottom + 20, { class: "bagging-chart-tick", "text-anchor": "middle" });
    });
    aucChart.append(svgElement("line", { x1: margin.left, y1: margin.top, x2: margin.left, y2: plotBottom, class: "bagging-chart-axis" }));
    aucChart.append(svgElement("line", { x1: margin.left, y1: plotBottom, x2: plotRight, y2: plotBottom, class: "bagging-chart-axis" }));
    const drawLegendItem = (x, label, color, dashed) => {
      aucChart.append(svgElement("line", {
        x1: x,
        y1: 18,
        x2: x + 18,
        y2: 18,
        stroke: color,
        "stroke-width": 2.8,
        "stroke-dasharray": dashed ? "6 4" : "",
      }));
      addText(aucChart, label, x + 24, 22, { class: "bagging-chart-note" });
    };
    drawLegendItem(margin.left, "Random forest", colors.forest, false);
    drawLegendItem(margin.left + 160, "Mean individual-tree AUC", colors.individual, true);

    const ensemblePath = ensembleAuc.slice(0, includedTrees).map((value, index) => (index === 0 ? "M" : "L") + xScale(index + 1).toFixed(2) + " " + yScale(value).toFixed(2)).join(" ");
    const individualPath = meanIndividualAuc.slice(0, includedTrees).map((value, index) => (index === 0 ? "M" : "L") + xScale(index + 1).toFixed(2) + " " + yScale(value).toFixed(2)).join(" ");
    aucChart.append(svgElement("path", { d: individualPath, class: "bagging-mean-tree-auc-line", style: "stroke: " + colors.individual }));
    aucChart.append(svgElement("path", { d: ensemblePath, class: "bagging-auc-line", style: "stroke: " + colors.forest }));
    const tooltip = svgElement("g", { class: "bagging-auc-tooltip", visibility: "hidden" });
    const tooltipBox = svgElement("rect", { x: 0, y: -19, width: 285, height: 22, rx: 3 });
    const tooltipText = svgElement("text", { x: 7, y: -5 });
    tooltip.append(tooltipBox, tooltipText);
    ensembleAuc.slice(0, includedTrees).forEach((value, index) => {
      const x = xScale(index + 1);
      const y = yScale(value);
      aucChart.append(svgElement("circle", { cx: x, cy: y, r: 1.75, class: "bagging-auc-point", style: "fill: " + colors.forest }));
      const hitTarget = svgElement("circle", { cx: x, cy: y, r: 6, class: "bagging-auc-hit-target", tabindex: 0 });
      const showTooltip = () => {
        const tooltipX = Math.min(plotRight - 286, Math.max(margin.left, x + 8));
        const tooltipY = Math.max(margin.top + 20, y - 5);
        tooltipText.textContent = "B: " + (index + 1)
          + " · Forest: " + value.toFixed(3)
          + " · Mean tree: " + meanIndividualAuc[index].toFixed(3);
        tooltip.setAttribute("transform", "translate(" + tooltipX + " " + tooltipY + ")");
        tooltip.setAttribute("visibility", "visible");
      };
      hitTarget.addEventListener("mouseenter", showTooltip);
      hitTarget.addEventListener("focus", showTooltip);
      hitTarget.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => tooltip.setAttribute("visibility", "hidden"));
      hitTarget.addEventListener("blur", () => tooltip.setAttribute("visibility", "hidden"));
      aucChart.append(hitTarget);
    });
    aucChart.append(tooltip);
    aucChart.append(svgElement("circle", { cx: xScale(includedTrees), cy: yScale(meanIndividualAuc[includedTrees - 1]), r: 4, fill: colors.individual, class: "bagging-auc-marker" }));
    aucChart.append(svgElement("circle", { cx: xScale(includedTrees), cy: yScale(ensembleAuc[includedTrees - 1]), r: 5, fill: colors.forest, class: "bagging-auc-marker" }));
    addText(aucChart, "Number of random-forest trees", (margin.left + plotRight) / 2, height - 11, { class: "bagging-chart-axis-title", "text-anchor": "middle" });
    const yTitle = addText(aucChart, "Held-out ROC AUC", 16, (margin.top + plotBottom) / 2, { class: "bagging-chart-axis-title", "text-anchor": "middle" });
    yTitle.setAttribute("transform", "rotate(-90 16 " + (margin.top + plotBottom) / 2 + ")");
  }

  function render() {
    treeCountOutput.textContent = String(includedTrees);
    renderBootstrapSummary();
    renderTreeCard();
    renderPredictionCard();
    drawAucChart();
  }

  function stopAnimation() {
    isRunning = false;
    if (animationFrame !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
    animationFrame = null;
  }

  function runAll(timestamp) {
    if (!isRunning) return;
    if (!lastFrameTime || timestamp - lastFrameTime >= 22) {
      // The one-step button reveals every tree. The animation advances two
      // at a time so that a full 200-tree run remains easy to watch.
      includedTrees = Math.min(nTrees, includedTrees + 2);
      render();
      lastFrameTime = timestamp;
    }
    if (includedTrees < nTrees) {
      animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(runAll);
    } else {
      stopAnimation();
    }
  }

  nextButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    stopAnimation();
    includedTrees = Math.min(nTrees, includedTrees + 1);
    render();
  });
  runButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    stopAnimation();
    if (includedTrees >= nTrees) includedTrees = 1;
    isRunning = true;
    lastFrameTime = 0;
    animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(runAll);
  });
  resetButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    stopAnimation();
    includedTrees = 1;
    render();
  });

  render();
})();
</script>
```
